paragraphs: Chapter 661
Episode 167. The Fifth Tomb of Temar (5)
From then on, the two began to wander around the empty space like ordinary siblings searching for something.
Luntia's steps were slow as she was tired, but ever since her senses had returned, she started to gradually feel the 'different energy' left in the empty space.

[I couldn't feel anything when I was engulfed in madness, but now that I'm back to my senses, I can clearly feel a different force in this empty space. There must be a reason why the empty space was broken.]
The 'different energy' Luntia spoke of referred to magical power.
Jin couldn't feel this magical power even when he heightened his senses. The aura was too strong.
Without Luntia's help, it would have been like finding a needle in a desert.
"Is Hister seriously injured?"
[Yes, I can only say sorry.]
"It's not your fault. As long as she's alive, we should be able to heal her somehow."
[What worries me is, like I said when I was out of my senses, she might have accepted the chaos. She was so badly injured that she couldn't have survived without it. My sword pierced her chest...]

"As I mentioned earlier, the first magic I saw didn't have any aura. Even if the magic record was made before the injury, if Hister were tainted with chaos, the magic should have been altered or disappeared. Don't worry too much, it's not your fault."
[Even if it were you, you wouldn't have been able to ignore your nanny, but if it were you... you would have definitely made a better choice than me.]

"No. Instead, if the Prophet's goal was to extract Sir Paddler from the tomb, your initial purpose here wasn't to track Hister. I was shocked when I received this hair from the knights guarding the outside."
[Hister encountered knights a few times during the tomb tracking process. She must have obtained the hair then. After Ronil Zipf let her escape, I was to replace Sir Paddler.]
The day Ronil let Valeria escape, Luntia was not yet consumed by chaos, and was before she replaced Paddler as the owner of the empty space.
From the beginning, Luntia was not chasing after Hister, she merely coincidentally overlapped with Valeria while searching for Temar's tomb.
In fact, Valeria benefited from Luntia's years of search, as she obtained a crucial clue that the tomb was in the Calderan Tundra by spying on Luntia's search.
"So it means... the personnel who were looking for Temar's tomb and those tracking Hister were separated. You were part of the former."

[That seems to be the case. Before I entered the empty space, I had never received an order to kill or capture Hister. I suspect such an order was given to the Black Knight or the 1st Division of the Black Sword Guild.]

Luntia's attack on Valeria in the tomb was purely due to her inability to control the murderous desire boiling up inside her as she was consumed by the madness of chaos. It was not an order she received.
Jin was now beginning to understand the situation.
This explains why Valeria entered the tomb in a hurry without even leaving a message for Ticani.

"Rosa and the Prophet must have thought that Sister Luntia wouldn't want to chase after Valeria. Moreover, since they were planning to make sister the owner of the A-Space anyway, they probably let her find the tomb to avoid unnecessary resentment."
For example, Rosa and the Prophet recognized the bond between Luntia and Jin.
Especially after Jin declared his estate, Rosa noticed the changed Luntia, she predicted that Luntia could become one with Jin at any time.
So, for Rosa, the best choice was to use Luntia as much as possible and then tie her to the tomb.
There were not many people who could replace Paddler, who had such a pure and strong soul.
If Luna had been in the Garden of Swords and if she had a weakness like Resham, Rosa would have used Luna to bring out Paddler without hesitation.
The time in A-Space and Inse differs.
So, although Jin was getting more and more anxious as time went by, he did not show it outwardly.
He knew that Luntia was doing her best with her broken body.
And if Jin left the tomb, Luntia would have to be alone for a while.
She would have to stay alone in this lonely and terrifying space, engulfed in the madness of chaos.
He didn't know when he would be able to find her again.
He didn't know how long it would take for the Chaos Purifier to solve the complete corrosion, and there was a high chance that Rosa would strengthen the boundaries of Calderan Snowfield after today.
While walking, Jin told his sister about what had happened.
Luntia laughed with envy and joy when she heard about the things Jin experienced in Raflarosa, and her face became heavy when she heard about the incidents that Jin encountered after his return.

[I see, you fought with Sir Paddler... I can't imagine how painful it must have been for you to face those engulfed in chaos every time. It must have been terrible for you to face Sir Ron, Sir Paddler, and now me.]

"Of course it hurts. But just as I'm having a conversation with you like a sister who has good friendship, I will return Sir Paddler to his original state. Just like I finally defeated Chaos with the late Sir Ron."
[I think I know why Luna sister adored you so much. It would have been nice if I had become close to you a little sooner.]
"I also didn't approach you first, didn't I? Of course, both of us had liked each other in our hearts since the declaration of the house."
[It's been a long time since I've felt this awkward. But... when I think about it, didn't you say that the means to enter here was the sword of the knight Hedora?]
"That's right."

[Ilina also said that one thing was needed to switch between me and Paddler. But unlike the sword you used as a key, it seemed to be a one-time consumable. She didn't insist that there was only one, but she explained it with that feeling.]

"Probably both Hedora's sword and the item that the Prophet used for you and Paddler are all related to the old Runcandel. In my case, I interacted with Hedora's sword through spiritual energy, and the Prophet probably made you interact with the item through Chaos."
"[I don't know why Zipple's monster butler has such an item.]
"He seemed not to know much about the sword either. If Zipple knew about the sword's true nature, he would have managed it more specially."
[Then did Hister also have something related to the ancient Runcandel? She didn't use any power other than magic.]
How on earth was Valeria able to enter this tomb?
Jin had always wondered about it.

'Judging from my and the Prophet's cases, even if it's an item related to ancient Runcandel, the probability of entering the tomb without using soul energy or chaos would be high. Perhaps the record devices of Solderet that I gave her became the key.'
He could not know until he heard it directly from Valeria.
Luntia's steps were faster than before.
It wasn't that she had recovered a bit of strength, but like Jin was considering her, she was trying her best to find Hister even a second faster.
[I think it's getting closer... The alien feeling transmitted through the aether space is getting stronger.]
Luntia pointed her finger far away into the void.
[There it is. I pushed myself... but I can no longer walk, I.]
In a state disconnected from the aether space, she cannot recover her body.
Luntia's two legs were now completely hardened like statues and immobile.
[Go on, youngest. I will wait here. Do not reconnect me with the aether space... I will attack you immediately.]
"Understood, sister."
As he approached the point Luntia indicated, his heart pounded like a hammer.
Now Jin could also feel Valeria's magic like Luntia.
Her magic was infinitely faint and unstable, like a pulse about to go out.
"Valeria."
Soon after, Jin stopped and called her name.
No response or reaction returned.
After calling her a few more times, Jin closed his eyes and raised his senses and soul energy.
Thanks to recovering some soul energy while walking, he could use the soul sword once.
He felt he needed to verify directly by cutting the aether space.
'I have to make sure Valeria doesn't get hurt when I cut the space.'
Reading the faint flowing magic, he estimated the depth.
Soon, Jin was able to gauge the distance, and swung his soul sword as it was.
Swish-!
The space opened.
"No!"
It wasn't Luntia's voice.
The voice was Nero's, of the Cat People.
He hadn't expected Nero to come from beyond the space.
Nero stood with his short arms wide open, clenching his teeth.
He was displaying a gesture unconsciously adopted by people trying to protect something.
[Jin...? Really, is it Jin Runcandel?]
Jin had forgotten to respond and was staring at the person behind who Nero had been protecting.
Valeria Hister, trapped in a tomb-like ice.
As Luntia had said, a large black wound could be seen in the middle of Valeria's chest.
"Valeria!"
When Jin entered the space, Nero swiped his chest.
[Jin, Valeria has sealed herself now. The wound was too deep, there was no other way.]
She is alive.
He had assumed so since her magic remained, but confirming Valeria with his own eyes, something hot surged up his throat.
"So, Nero, have you been with Valeria all this time?"
[Yes, since the first time I came here. Luntia Runcandel does not know this. Luntia Runcandel? Is that person behind you...?]
"It's too long to explain. Let's get out of here for now, Nero. From the looks of her magic, the seal won't hold much longer."
[Yes, I've already prepared the way out. We couldn't leave because Valeria couldn't move.]
Nero took out the claw of the Cat God from his bosom.
It was the item that the Cat People had cherished thanks to Valeria in the past in Wontaramo forest.
As Nero immediately tried to open the door to escape the aether space using the claw, Jin looked back at Luntia.
She was waving her hand, as if to hurry him along.
As they did at their first meeting after the declaration of the domain, the two were reading each other's minds without speaking.
'I'll be back soon, sister.'
'Be careful, youngest.'
The door to escape the aether space opened, and Luntia stared blankly at the place where they disappeared for a while.
